identificationModule.briefTitle: Effectiveness and Safety of Semaglutide Combined With Dietary Fiber (Soloways) in Adults With Overweight or Obesity
identificationModule.officialTitle: Effectiveness and Safety of Semaglutide Combined With Dietary Fiber (Soloways) in Adults With Overweight or Obesity: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Double-Blind Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This clinical trial investigated the combined effects of Semaglutide and a fiber supplement (glucomannan, inulin, psyllium) on weight loss in adults with overweight or obesity. Participants, aged 18-65 with a BMI ≥30 or ≥27 with comorbidities, were randomized into two groups: one receiving Semaglutide with active fiber supplements and the other with Semaglutide and placebo, over a 180-day period. Key endpoints included percentage change in body weight, BMI, body composition, safety, and appetite control, with a focus on evaluating the additive effects of dietary fibers in enhancing Semaglutide's efficacy.

armGroups.label: Semaglutide with Active Fiber Supplement Group

interventions.name: Fiber Supplement Group
interventions.description: Semaglutide (2.4 mg weekly). Three daily packets of active fiber supplement (each containing 1g of glucomannan, 1g of inulin, and 3g of psyllium), taken 30 minutes before each main meal. The supplement is provided by S.Lab (Soloways), LLC.
armGroupLabels: Semaglutide with Active Fiber Supplement Group

interventions.name: placebo
interventions.description: Semaglutide (2.4 mg weekly). Three daily packets of placebo powder, taken 30 minutes before each main meal.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage change in body weight from baseline
Achievement of a reduction in body weight of 5% or more from baseline.

secondaryOutcomes.description: fat mass change assessed using bioelectrical impedance analysis

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety evaluated by recording any adverse events.

secondaryOutcomes.description: fat-free mass change assessed using bioelectrical impedance analysis
visceral fat rating change assessed using bioelectrical impedance analysis
total body water change assessed using bioelectrical impedance analysis

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI ≥30, or ≥27 with comorbidities.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serious chronic illnesses.
* History of bulimia or anorexia.
* Pregnancy or lactation.
